title: MedGemma vs GPT-4: Open-Source and Proprietary Zero-shot Medical Disease Classification from Images
abstract: arXiv:2512.23304v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (LLMs) introduce an emerging paradigm for medical imaging by interpreting scans through the lens of extensive clinical knowledge, offering a transformative approach to disease classification. This study presents a critical comparison between two fundamentally different AI architectures: the specialized open-source agent MedGemma and the proprietary large multimodal model GPT-4 for diagnosing six different diseases. The MedGemma-4b-it model, fine-tuned using Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), demonstrated superior diagnostic capability by achieving a mean test accuracy of 80.37% compared to 69.56% for the untuned GPT-4. Furthermore, MedGemma exhibited notably higher sensitivity in high-stakes clinical tasks, such as cancer and pneumonia detection. translated_title: MedGemma 与 GPT-4 对比：基于图像的开源与专有模型零样本医学疾病分类
translated_abstract: 多模态大语言模型（LLMs）通过结合广泛的临床知识来解读医学扫描图像，为医学影像领域引入了一种新兴范式，为疾病分类提供了变革性的方法。本研究对两种根本不同的AI架构进行了关键性比较：专门的开源智能体MedGemma与专有的大型多模态模型GPT-4，用于诊断六种不同的疾病。经低秩适应微调的MedGemma-4b-it模型展现出卓越的诊断能力，平均测试准确率达到80.37%，而未经调优的GPT-4仅为69.56%。此外，MedGemma在癌症和肺炎检测等高风险临床任务中表现出明显更高的敏感性。通过混淆矩阵和分类报告进行的定量分析为模型在所有类别上的表现提供了全面的洞察。
tldr: 经LoRA微调的开源MedGemma模型在零样本医学图像疾病分类任务中以80.37%的平均准确率超越了专有的GPT-4（69.56%），并在癌症和肺炎等高危疾病检测中表现出更高的敏感性。
